ios.desc:
Understand what your dreams mean, remember them every morning, and learn to lucid dream. Lucidity brings AI dream interpretation, a private dream journal, and a step-by-step lucid dreaming guide together in one calm app.

AI DREAM INTERPRETATION & MEANING
Write or record a dream and get a personal interpretation in seconds:
• AI dream analysis: discover the meaning behind recurring dreams, nightmares, and vivid dreams.
• Personal dream dictionary: symbols, themes, characters, and places are extracted automatically from every entry.
• Emotion wheel: see your dream emotions mapped on Plutchik's wheel and how they connect to your waking life.

LEARN LUCID DREAMING STEP BY STEP
A structured journey with morning and evening lessons, for beginners and experienced dreamers:
• Proven techniques: MILD, WILD, SSILD, and WBTB, with guided practice screens.
• Reality check reminders: build the habit that wakes you up inside your dreams.
• Learn the science: REM sleep, sleep cycles, dream recall, and dream control in bite-sized lessons.

YOUR PRIVATE DREAM JOURNAL
• Write or voice-record your dreams the moment you wake up, before they fade.
• Streaks, reminders, and a calendar heatmap keep your journaling habit alive.
• Charts and stats: track dream recall, lucidity rate, sleep quality, and your top dream symbols.
• Search your whole journal by symbol, mood, lucid tag, or date.

100% PRIVATE BY DESIGN
Your dreams belong to you. Your journal stays on your device, works offline, and can be locked with a passcode or Face ID.

MORE
• Export your dream journal as a PDF.
• Dark themes made for late-night and early-morning writing.

FREE TO USE, PRO WHEN YOU'RE READY
Lucidity is free to download, and the dream journal and most features are free to use. Upgrade to Lucidity Pro (subscription or one-time Lifetime purchase) to unlock unlimited AI dream analysis, the full lucid dreaming course, and more.

Start tonight: record your first dream, discover what it means, and take your first step toward lucid dreaming.

Terms & Conditions: https://luciditydreams.com/terms/

android.desc:
Lucidity is the all-in-one lucid dream journal, private dream diary, and AI dream interpretation app designed to help you remember your dreams, understand your dream meanings, and master lucid dreaming.

Whether you want a daily sleep journal to improve dream recall, an intelligent dream dictionary to decode hidden symbols, or a step-by-step guide to have your first lucid dream in a few weeks, Lucidity is the ultimate dream app for your nightly journey.

🔮 AI DREAM INTERPRETATION & DREAM MEANINGS
Uncover what your subconscious mind is telling you. Our advanced dream AI reads every entry in your dream journal to provide instant, personalized dream interpretation and meaning:
• AI Dream Analyzer: Discover the deeper dream meanings behind recurring dreams, nightmares, and vivid sleep stories.
• Dream Dictionary & Symbols: Automatically extract dream symbols, themes, characters, and settings to build your personal dream dictionary.
• Emotion Mapping: Visualize your sleep and dreaming patterns on a Plutchik emotion wheel to see how your waking life connects to your dreams.

🌟 LEARN LUCID DREAMING
Anyone can learn how to lucid dream! Follow a structured lucid dreaming journey with morning and evening lessons designed to trigger consciousness while you sleep:
• Proven Lucid Dream Techniques: Learn and practice MILD, WILD, SSILD, and WBTB with guided in-app practice screens.
• Reality Check Reminders: Customize daily reality check alerts and totems to build the habit of questioning reality and waking up inside your dreams.
• Lucid Dreaming Guide: Master sleep theory, REM sleep cycles, and dream control with bite-sized lessons for beginners and experienced lucid dreamers.

📔 THE ULTIMATE PRIVATE DREAM JOURNAL & DIARY
Building a morning sleep journal habit is effortless when your diary journal is fast, calm, and organized:
• Daily Dream Diary & Log: Write or voice-record your dreams the moment you wake up before they fade.
• Sleep Journal Calendar & Streaks: Keep your dreaming habit alive with daily journaling reminders, streaks, and a visual calendar heatmap.
• Advanced Charts & Tracker: Track your dream recall, lucidity rate, sleep quality, word count, and top dream symbols over time.
• Search & Filter: Instantly search your entire dream book by symbol, mood, lucid tag, or date.

🔐 100% PRIVATE & SECURE BY DESIGN

quotes.text:
I built a mobile app called Lucidity (luciditydreams.com) aimed at helping people have their first lucid dream:

iOS: https://apps.apple.com/us/app/lucidity-lucid-dream-journal/id6505020545

Android: https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=ch.b3nz.lucidity&hl=en&gl=US

Started building it 14 years ago after reading an article about lucid dreaming in my favorite science magazine, and no other apps out there existed to assist you with reality checks and the different induction methods. Recently added a 7-day lucid dreaming journey to guide you to your first lucid dream. I worked with lucid dreaming researchers for the program's content.

Feedback welcome!
